coverage_assessment: Four weekly windows searched across French/English news, unions, education, health, transport, market prices, political/opposition, human-rights/security and major southern/northern cities. Local-language discovery attempts for Fon, Yoruba, Bariba, Dendi and Fulfulde yielded no relevant material. Web search is not LexisNexis or exhaustive; rural/local archives and languages remain uneven. E001 is a press-event lead pending public-access/participant evidence, not a confirmed qualifying protest.
